source.note: 1995 Score Summit Baseball hobby product. The 200-card flagship checklist remains one collector-facing VCS Base ProductSet. The full 200-card Nth Degree parallel and the three ordinary pack insert families (New Age, 21 Club, Big Bang) are modeled. The dealer-distributed Samples promo set is excluded because it was not an ordinary sealed-pack outcome.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS-normalized pack: 4 cards per pack, 24 packs per box. The physical hobby product was documented as seven cards per pack; VCS uses the standing four-card pack rule while preserving verified per-pack insert frequencies.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-200 remains one VCS Base ProductSet with equal availability for completion and prestige tracking. Nth Degree is kept as one complete 200-card parallel checklist.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: True RC status is taken from the TCDB rookie-card index. Only the 11 verified flagship rookie cards receive RC appended to Player; the broader #112-173 Rookies subset does not imply RC status.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject name plus verified RC when applicable. ROO, UER and similar collector annotations are removed from Player and may remain only as card metadata.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Verified pack odds live only on ProductSets. Nth Degree is 1:4, New Age 1:18, 21 Club 1:36 and Big Bang 1:72. No card Variant contains set-wide odds.
decisions.subsetModeling: Base subset labels follow the collector-facing structure: Rookies #112-173, Bat Speed #174-188, Special Delivery #189-193 and Checklist #194-200. Nth Degree mirrors those same numbered subjects and subset labels.
decisions.errorHandling: Uncorrected printing-error annotations are never included in Player. They are not modeled as duplicate cards because the source set has no corrected companion versions.
decisions.excludedRelatedSets: The dealer Samples promo issue is excluded from this sealed-pack Product.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-200. Eleven TCDB-recognized true RCs receive the RC suffix; rookie-themed subset membership alone does not.
